name: Helmora-Web v2
author: HelmoraAI
description: Helmora Web application with a built-in same-origin reverse proxy for Helmora-Hub.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /mnt/server
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run build

variables.name: Hub URL
variables.description: Private or public HTTP(S) origin for Helmora-Hub; do not include credentials
